description:
Return aggregated battery metrics for ONE specific device: average / min / max
temperature, average battery level, mean charge time per power source (AC, USB,
wireless) and mean discharge time over a recent (~2 weeks) and a long (~2 months)
window, plus awake ratio and basic device info. Also includes `url`: the public
BatterySnap web page for this device's interactive battery history
(https://www.battery-snap.com/device_history?device=<uid>). All values are pre-computed
from the device's full snapshot history — no raw timeseries is returned.

device_uid.description: Stable device UUID returned by the `devices` tool.

name: device_summary

avg_battery_level_pct.description: Mean battery charge level across all snapshots (0-100).

avg_temperature_c.description: Mean battery temperature in Celsius across all snapshots.

awake_ratio.description: Fraction of observed time the device was awake / screen-on (0..1).

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the earliest snapshot.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent snapshot.

max_temperature_c.description: Hottest battery temperature in Celsius ever observed. Sustained highs are a battery-health concern.

mean_ac_charge_hours_long.description: Hours to charge 100%% on AC over the last ~2 months.

mean_ac_charge_hours_recent.description: Hours to charge 100%% on AC (wall charger) over the last ~2 weeks.

mean_discharge_hours_long.description: Average hours to discharge 100%% over the last ~2 months.

mean_discharge_hours_recent.description: Average hours to discharge 100%% over the last ~2 weeks. Null when not enough data.

mean_usb_charge_hours_long.description: Hours to charge 100%% over USB over the last ~2 months.

mean_usb_charge_hours_recent.description: Hours to charge 100%% over USB (computer) over the last ~2 weeks.

mean_wireless_charge_hours_long.description: Hours to charge 100%% wirelessly over the last ~2 months.

mean_wireless_charge_hours_recent.description: Hours to charge 100%% wirelessly over the last ~2 weeks.

min_temperature_c.description: Coldest battery temperature in Celsius ever observed.

observed_days.description: Span in days between first_seen and last_seen.

raw_model.description: Raw Build.MODEL string reported by the device.

snapshot_count.description: Total snapshots recorded for this device.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone reported by the device.

url.description: Public BatterySnap web page showing this device's interactive battery history, e.g. https://www.battery-snap.com/device_history?device=<uid>. Locale-agnostic.

title: Device battery summary
